Rules effectively keep devices off wrestlers during matches: NFHS 4-3-5 bars wristbands/sleeves without a pad and NFHS casebook says a wrestler cannot wear jewelry (NFHS 2025-26); OHSAA GSR 20.3 (restated Oct 7, 2025) says contact-sport athletes should not wear heart-monitoring equipment in contests. targets.competition_rule: NFHS Rule 4-3-5 (no wristbands/sleeves without a pad during a match), NFHS 4-3-6 (no coach-to-wrestler communication devices), casebook 3.1.4 (no jewelry). OHSAA GSR 20.3: collision/contact-sport athletes should not wear heart monitoring equipment in interscholastic contests unless the sport code says otherwise. These are competition rules only; an overnight band worn at home is not addressed by them.
